name: Western Atlantic University School of Medicine

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Western Atlantic University School of Medicine (WAUSM) is a contemporary medical institution designed to provide you with a world-class education that leads to US and Canadian medical licensure. The university is led by a team of experienced US medical education leaders who have trained over 25,000 physicians. WAUSM’s curriculum is built on the pillars of selectivity and accessibility, focusing on a student-centered approach that integrates clinical skills from day one. The university is officially accredited by the Caribbean Accreditation Authority for Education in Medicine and Other Health Professions (CAAM-HP).

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Life at WAUSM is centered on a collaborative, team-based learning environment. You will find a community of like-minded, ambitious individuals from diverse backgrounds. The university emphasizes your well-being alongside academic excellence, offering individualized support to help you navigate the rigours of medical school. Beyond the classroom, the location in Freeport allows you to enjoy a vibrant island culture while maintaining focus on your professional goals.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
WAUSM offers support for students seeking housing near the Freeport campus. You can choose from various modern, safe, and comfortable apartments located within a short distance of the academic facilities. These housing options are specifically vetted to ensure they meet the needs of medical students, providing quiet study environments and necessary amenities.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library: The university provides access to extensive digital medical libraries and research databases. These resources are designed to support your case-based learning and provide the most current evidence for clinical care.
  2. Sports: While the campus is focused on intensive medical training, you have access to local fitness centres and outdoor recreational activities in Freeport, including swimming, diving, and coastal sports to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.
  3. Laboratories: WAUSM features world-class simulation laboratories where you can practice clinical skills in a safe, controlled environment. These facilities include high-fidelity mannequins and standardized patient exam rooms to mimic real-world medical scenarios.
  4. Cafeteria: The Freeport campus includes dining areas where you can grab fresh meals and beverages between lectures. There are also numerous local cafes and international dining options located within walking distance of the university.

highlights.title: Campuses
highlights.value:
Freeport, Grand Bahama The pre-clerkship campus is located just 80 miles from Florida in Freeport. This is where you will spend the first 20 months of your MD program. The campus is a high-tech facility specifically designed for modern medical education, featuring integrated classrooms and simulation labs.

US Partner Hospitals For the second half of your degree (Years 3 and 4), you will move to the United States. WAUSM has established a network of partner teaching hospitals across the US where you will complete your clinical clerkships. These rotations are designed to prepare you directly for your residency match.

highlights.title: Employability
highlights.value: WAUSM is highly focused on your career outcomes. The university achieved a 100% residency match rate for its students in the US and Canada, a testament to the strength of its MD program. You will receive dedicated guidance for the USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Examination) and comprehensive support through the residency application process, including mock interviews and career mentoring.
